proposed.condition_limit: The list permission is authorized on the bucket resource and cannot itself constrain returned object names to a prefix. The dedicated witness-only bucket, application-side exact-prefix validation, generation-pinned reads and complete-chain validation remain mandatory. IAM Conditions are not claimed as complete object-level isolation.

required_properties.binding: exact Windows service principal to exactly one cloud service account
required_properties.acquisition: short-lived service-account access-token impersonation from an independently authenticated non-exportable source credential
required_properties.scope: devstorage.read_write for Writer; devstorage.read_only for Reader
required_properties.audience: Google OAuth token endpoint / Cloud Storage API only; no reusable bearer token may be persisted
required_properties.rotation_revocation: revoke the exact impersonation binding/source credential; cached tokens expire and every refresh fails closed
required_properties.failure: no fallback identity, shared token, user-managed key or Owner interactive credential
required_properties.audit: Cloud Audit Logs plus local correlation ID without token material
required_properties.recovery: Kernel halts; Recovery has no standing Writer/Reader impersonation

approval_blockers: No approved operational local keyless source credential or Windows-service-to-service-account binding exists.
Current bucket roles are unconditioned predefined roles; proposed custom roles and conditions are not deployed.
Project legacy basic-principal bucket bindings can bypass the proposed Writer/Reader restrictions and require a separately reviewed safe removal/replacement plan.
The Owner user currently has serviceAccountTokenCreator on both identities; this is historical test access, not accepted operational custody.
Live negative enforcement and revocation probes cannot occur until a separately approved IAM change.
